title: Admin — Generic Shell
description: Per-instance admin landing scaffold + portable nav-from-registry factory. Consumer supplies a SliceRegistryAdapter (each slice declares its own admin.activity[]) and a queryTable reader; the slice's buildAdminStats(opts) emits the { counts, unreadMessages, activity } shape Convex's admin.stats query returns. Pure UI/factory — no Convex tables owned. Gated by requireAdmin on Convex side; superadmin email gate via SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL env.

peers.reason: requireAdmin gate uses convex-auth user identity.
